scope: All 30 previously published products, excluding the pre-existing draft hairpin and excluding the 16 additions. This report records observations before root changes publication status.
acceptance: Either an officially verified operating public retail channel currently associated with the brand/jewelry, with exact-SKU store stock explicitly unconfirmed, or a live priced SKU with visible enabled order UI and no observed sold-out state. Explicit item-level unavailability overrides general maker-shop existence for the strict buyable selection.
method: Read-only fresh Chrome DOM for all distinct old-product URLs, followed by visibility/disabled-state checks; current official web body reads for Hamamatsuya catalog/store and Maruyama category/store. No order/enquiry. Image/font requests were blocked during text DOM sampling; missing image-label cart controls were not inferred as online-confirmed. The seven retained retail/catalog items and explicitly unavailable Hamamatsuya18K use separately identified official web-reader body evidence. Hamamatsuya Chrome body-null failures are retained as failures, and are never substituted with a successful DOM claim.

rows.rationale: Current priced maker catalog lists the accessory without a sold-out label, and the maker publishes its operating main retail shop. This is the verified-retail-channel gate, not proof of the exact SKU or pattern on the shelf.
limits: No order, cart addition, payment, enquiry or reservation was performed.
No nationwide or all-variant stock guarantee.
Public store operation and brand handling are separate from featured-SKU store stock.

limitations: Observations are dated, not a fulfilled-order or future-availability guarantee.
Shop Channel availability differs by color/fitting; at least the displayed white options have quantity selection, whereas some peacock options lack selection.
Yukieglass states online/atelier stock is shared and a later shortage is possible.
Made-to-order and supplier lead-time products may be orderable without being immediately dispatchable.
GitHub Pages commercial-hosting suitability and image/design-rights clearance are separate questions.
